sara-cs: Heads-up: SolaceWorks renewal — finance wants invoice to SolaceWorks Ltd (UK) but payment will be routed from SolaceWorks Inc (US card). They need an invoice today to attach to internal PO. Can legal/finance advise?
henry-am: Are we keeping the 12mo term? Any pricing or credit asks?
sara-cs: Term stays 12mo. Customer asked for a 3% setup credit if we accept mixed-entity billing. PO: SW-PO-3344. Signer: "Olivia T., VP Finance".
lucy-legal: Mixed-entity payor requires either (A) UK VAT registration proof + vendor code, or (B) signed remit authorization + indemnity clause. We can accept DocuSign for the addendum.
mike-billing: Ops: we can issue invoice to SolaceWorks Ltd in GBP, accept wire to UK bank, or accept US card with signed authorization. If CC used we need vendor code and tax form. Please confirm payor preference and provide vendor code.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.com/envelope/SW-ADD-9001 status: sent (1 pending).
sara-cs: Sent PO snippet and asked customer to sign addendum and confirm whether they will wire or use CC backup.
henry-am: I'll hold the 3% credit request pending legal signoff. If indemnity required we likely can't give credit.
lucy-legal: Agreed. If they sign and provide VAT reg, proceed without indemnity. Otherwise include indemnity clause and hold credit.
mike-billing: I'll draft invoice templates (GBP to UK entity; payor field = SolaceWorks Inc optional) and hold send until DocuSign complete. ETA 30m.
sara-cs: Thanks — I'll update when envelope signed or if customer confirms wire. :thumbsup:
